ac-17 ::= [\]] ac-17-01 | [^\]] ac-17
ac-17-01 ::= [\]] ac-17-02 | [^\]] ac-17
ac-17-02 ::= [>] | [\]] ac-17-02 | [^>\]] ac-17
ac-31 ::= [<] ac-31-01 | [^<] ac-31
ac-31-01 ::= [<] ac-31-01 | [/] ac-31-02 | [^/<] ac-31
ac-31-02 ::= [<] ac-31-01 | [p] ac-31-03 | [^<p] ac-31
ac-31-03 ::= [<] ac-31-01 | [a] ac-31-04 | [^<a] ac-31
ac-31-04 ::= [<] ac-31-01 | [r] ac-31-05 | [^<r] ac-31
ac-31-05 ::= [<] ac-31-01 | [a] ac-31-06 | [^<a] ac-31
ac-31-06 ::= [<] ac-31-01 | [m] ac-31-07 | [^<m] ac-31
ac-31-07 ::= [>] | [<] ac-31-01 | [^<>] ac-31
decimal-part ::= [0-9]{1,16}
integral-part ::= [0] | [1-9] [0-9]{0,15}
json-array ::= "[" space ("]" | json-value (space "," space json-value)* space "]")
json-bool ::= "true" | "false"
json-null ::= "null"
json-number ::= "-"? ("0" | [1-9] [0-9]*) ("." [0-9]+)? (("e" | "E") [+-]? [0-9]+)?
json-object ::= "{" space ("}" | json-string space ":" space json-value (space "," space json-string space ":" space json-value)* space "}")
json-string ::= "\"" ( [^"\\] | "\\" ( ["\\/ bfnrt] | "u" [0-9a-fA-F]{4} ) )* "\""
json-value ::= json-object | json-array | json-string | json-number | json-bool | json-null
number ::= ("-"? integral-part) ("." decimal-part)? ([eE] [-+]? integral-part)?
root ::= tool-call
space ::= | " " | "\n"{1,2} [ \t]{0,20}
tool-0 ::= ("<function name=\"" "logistics.trace_shipment" "\">") space ((("<param name=\"" "tracking_no" "\">") ("<![CDATA[" ac-17 "</param>" | ac-31)) space)* space "</function>"
tool-1 ::= ("<function name=\"" "logistics.reroute_shipment" "\">") space ((("<param name=\"" "tracking_no" "\">") ("<![CDATA[" ac-17 "</param>" | ac-31)) space)* space "</function>"
tool-2 ::= ("<function name=\"" "logistics.estimate_delivery" "\">") space ((("<param name=\"" "tracking_no" "\">") ("<![CDATA[" ac-17 "</param>" | ac-31)) space)* space "</function>"
tool-3 ::= ("<function name=\"" "addresses.validate" "\">") space ((("<param name=\"" "address_id" "\">") ("<![CDATA[" ac-17 "</param>" | ac-31)) space)* space "</function>"
tool-4 ::= ("<function name=\"" "customs.declare_value" "\">") space ((("<param name=\"" "tracking_no" "\">") ("<![CDATA[" ac-17 "</param>" | ac-31) | ("<param name=\"" "amount" "\">") tool-4-arg-1-schema "</param>") space)* space "</function>"
tool-4-arg-1-schema ::= "{" space tool-4-arg-1-schema-value-kv "," space tool-4-arg-1-schema-unit-kv space "}"
tool-4-arg-1-schema-unit ::= ("\"CNY\"" | "\"USD\"" | "\"EUR\"" | "\"pcs\"" | "\"kg\"")
tool-4-arg-1-schema-unit-kv ::= "\"unit\"" space ":" space tool-4-arg-1-schema-unit
tool-4-arg-1-schema-value-kv ::= "\"value\"" space ":" space number
tool-5 ::= ("<function name=\"" "labels.generate" "\">") space ((("<param name=\"" "order_id" "\">") ("<![CDATA[" ac-17 "</param>" | ac-31)) space)* space "</function>"
tool-6 ::= ("<function name=\"" "couriers.list_rates" "\">") space ((("<param name=\"" "zone" "\">") ("<![CDATA[" ac-17 "</param>" | ac-31)) space)* space "</function>"
tool-7 ::= ("<function name=\"" "escalations.open_case" "\">") space ((("<param name=\"" "tracking_no" "\">") ("<![CDATA[" ac-17 "</param>" | ac-31)) space)* space "</function>"
tool-call ::= ((tool-0 | tool-1 | tool-2 | tool-3 | tool-4 | tool-5 | tool-6 | tool-7) space)+
